title: PCW-13 — Shared progress and contribution rules
intent: Keep ten friends contributing without lost progress or surprise overwrites.

criteria.text: Server-owned session fund starts at zero; Q01/Q02/Q03/Q04/Q06 first clears pay 20 once, explicit replays pay 10 once, Q05 pays zero, and rewards are not multiplied by player count.
Activity, round, step, action, completion, and purchase receipts deduplicate repeated taps, saves, retries, and reconnects.
Rejoining the same session restores committed state and accepted steps; a new session starts empty.
Activity adapters validate actor, round, accepted steps, and completion before calling the shared completion API.
